disposition.reason: The Benoits appealed the DRB's denial of permits to convert the main building back from five to four units and legalize an existing rear dwelling. The net unit count is unchanged and nothing new is built, so it is not new housing.

evidence.quote: the Benoits once again applied to the Development Review Board, this time for a permit to convert the main apartment building back to four units
a permit authorizing the use of the rear building as a residential unit
The DRB denied their application and the Benoits appealed to the Environmental Court
Judge Wright therefore enjoined further use of the rear building as a residential unit

judgments.note: Person ruling: no new construction and no net new units is not new housing.
